examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Return the real promise from `onAction`. The button shows a pending state while it runs, then a success state, then returns to idle.

examples.title: Custom labels
examples.description: `pendingLabel` and `successLabel` say what is happening and what happened. The idle `label` stays the accessible name.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: The same three text sizes as Button.

examples.title: Failure and retry
examples.description: If the promise rejects the button returns to idle so the user can retry, and `onActionError` is the place for visible error UI. Failures are also announced to screen readers.

examples.title: Keep the success state
examples.description: `resetAfterMs={0}` keeps the success state until the next action.

examples.title: Observe the state
examples.description: `onStateChange` reports `idle`, `pending` and `success` for surrounding UI. The component still owns the state.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled action button cannot be pressed.
